title: Downward-facing dog

steps.text: Start on your hands and knees with your hands slightly ahead of your shoulders.
steps.cue: Hands and knees, hands a little ahead.

steps.text: Lift your hips up and back and straighten your arms.
steps.cue: Lift your hips up and back.

steps.text: Bend your knees as much as you need and let your heels lift.
steps.cue: Bend your knees as much as you need.

steps.text: Press the mat away and keep your neck long.
steps.cue: Press the mat away. Neck long.

steps.text: Hold for a few breaths, then lower your knees down.
steps.cue: Hold and breathe, then lower your knees.

mistakes: Letting the shoulders creep up toward the ears.
Locking the knees to force the heels down.
regression: Keep your knees deeply bent, or do the halfway lift instead.
stopIf: Come down if you feel dizzy or your wrists or shoulders hurt.

anatomy.why: The arms and shoulders push the floor away, which sends the hips up and lengthens the back of the legs.
